docs.title: Dragon Customer Support
docs.text: Welcome to Dragon Customer Support — your central place for product help, troubleshooting, account assistance, and frequently asked questions.

docs.title: 🔍 How can we help you?
docs.text:
Find quick answers and helpful resources for your Dragon products.

### 🚀 Getting Started New to Dragon? Learn the basics, installation, setup, and activation. **Topics** - Installation - Setup - Activation - Getting started ### 👤 Account & Access Get help with your Dragon account and access-related questions. **Topics** - Login - Password - Account settings - Access problems ### 💳 Orders & Billing Find information about orders, payments, subscriptions, and billing. **Topics** - Orders - Payments - Billing - Subscriptions ### 🛠️ Technical Support Having a problem? Find troubleshooting information for common issues. **Topics** - Errors - Installation problems - Updates - Performance

docs.title: 🔧 Quick Troubleshooting
docs.text: Before contacting support, try these simple solutions.

docs.title: 1. Restart Dragon
docs.text: Close Dragon completely and start the application again.

docs.title: 2. Check your connection
docs.text: Make sure your internet connection is working correctly.

docs.title: 3. Check for updates
docs.text: Make sure you're using the latest available version of your Dragon product.

docs.title: 4. Restart your device
docs.text: Restarting your computer or device can resolve temporary issues.

docs.title: 5. Check the error message
docs.text: If Dragon displays an error, save the exact error message so support can help you faster.

docs.title: How do I get started with Dragon?
docs.text: Install your Dragon product and follow the setup instructions. Complete the activation process if required.

docs.title: Why isn't Dragon working?
docs.text: Restart Dragon first and check for available updates. If the problem continues, contact Dragon Support.

docs.title: I can't access my account. What should I do?
docs.text: Check your login information and try the password recovery option if necessary.

docs.title: How can I get technical help?
docs.text: Review the troubleshooting information above. If you still need assistance, contact Dragon Customer Support.

docs.title: 📋 Before Contacting Support
docs.text:
Please have the following information ready:

  • Dragon product name
  • Product version
  • Operating system
  • Description of the issue
  • Exact error message
  • Steps that caused the problem

This information helps our support team resolve your issue faster.

docs.title: 📞 Need More Help?
docs.text:
Can't find the answer you're looking for?

Dragon Customer Support is here to help with:

  • Product questions
  • Installation and setup
  • Account issues
  • Billing and orders
  • Technical problems

docs.title: Contact Dragon Support
docs.text: Please provide as much information about your problem as possible when contacting support.
